inputs.label: Crash Team Racing disc image (NTSC-U, SCUS-94426)
inputs.help: Your own US disc image of Crash Team Racing as a raw .bin. qgp copies it as ctr-u.bin.

steps.why: The guide has the user allow file access on the first start.

steps.text: Open CTR Turbocharged VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for file access, allow it and start the app again.

notes: Only a raw .bin of SCUS-94426 works; the guide does not say what happens with a .cue next to it.
